ارتقيتن (form VIII)
# اِرْتَقَيْتُنَّ (irtaqaytunna) /ir.ta.qaj.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِرْتَقَى (irtaqā)
# اُرْتُقِيتُنَّ (urtuqītunna) /ur.tu.qiː.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِرْتَقَى (irtaqā)
